results.title: Guinea-Bissau delays elections for two years to 2028
results.content: Guinea-Bissau’s military rulers have pushed back presidential and parliamentary elections by two years, delaying the country’s promised return to civilian rule.

results.title: Ebola: UN says outbreak driving spike in gender-based violence in Congo
results.content: In the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, the Ebola outbreak is increasing the vulnerability of women and girls, exposing them to a rise in gender-based violence, according to UNICEF

results.title: Extreme heat threatens pregnant women in South Africa’s informal settlements
results.content: Inside this antenatal unit in Mamelodi south africa, expectant mothers are battling dizziness, swollen feet and exhaustion as temperatures soar. In nearby informal settlements, extreme heat is raising fears of premature births and putting maternal health at risk.

results.title: American artist showcases plants in YSL Marrakech Museum in Morocco
results.content: Fifty drawings, watercolours, oil paintings, and ink on paper pieces by Dan McCleary showcase the Majorelle Jardin's flora.

results.title: US-backed Ebola quarantine centre violated constitution, Kenyan court rules
results.content: A Kenyan court on Thursday ruled that the government had breached the constitution by allowing the construction of a US-backed Ebola quarantine site at a military base in Laikipia.

results.title: Italy's Meloni concerned after Ukraine attack on Russian ship in Libya
results.content: Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni spoke in Brussels ahead of a European Union leaders’ meeting convened to discuss the bloc’s next long-term budget and a new loan to help Ukraine meet its economic and military needs

results.title: Egypt says 31 dead in Cairo fuel truck inferno, one man arrested
results.content: A fuel truck overturned on Wednesday, triggering a massive blaze that engulfed nearby vehicles. At least 31 people have been killed in the deadly fire. A man has been arrested in connection with the incident.

results.title: UN human rights chief warns of risk of escalating violence in western Nigeria
results.content: Dozens of people have been killed in a spate of attacks and reprisals linked to disputes betwen herders and farmers.

results.title: DRC–Uganda tensions escalate as Kinshasa summons Ugandan diplomat
results.content: Tensions are rising between the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda following controversial statements by Uganda’s army chief, General Muhoozi Kainerugaba.

results.title: Senegal parliament denounces president over budget decree
results.content: Senegal's parliament on Wednesday adopted a resolution criticizing President Bassirou Diomaye Faye's decision ​to implement a budget bill for 2026 that ‌lawmakers had previously rejected

results.title: Guinea orders massive clean-up operation of dumped rubbish in Conakry
results.content: Garbage has been piling up on the streets of Conakry since the closure of a dangerous landfill a few months ago. Guinea has ordered residents in the capital to conduct a massive clean-up operation by the end of the year.

results.title: Pix of the Day, 26th November 2026: South Africa's Biovac bets on African vaccine production
results.content: South Africa’s Biovac said Wednesday that a new manufacturing facility aims to dramatically increase African production of vaccines by the end of 2028 to help reduce the continent’s heavy reliance on imported doses.

results.title: Energy: Africa's industrial push meets transition pressures [Business Africa]
results.content: Africa wants to industrialize but it's being told it's time to decarbonize. Policymakers counter that leaping into an energy transition now would be suicidal for the continent's development and industrial ambitions. They insist that they are not against clean energy — only the timeline

results.title: Sierra Leone sees steep decline in maternal mortality but challenges remain
results.content: Maternal mortality has largely declined over the past 20 years in Sierra Leone. Despite the progress, unofficial fees, mistrust, and poor infrastructure continue to hinder access to maternity care.

results.title: War in Ukraine: Russia ignores claims on troop casualty figures
results.content: Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov on Wednesday declined to comment on claims that around 700,000 Russian soldiers have been killed in the Ukraine war so far.

results.title: Ebola fight runs up against customs, rites in remote DR Congo
results.content: For health workers in the volatile eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), tackling local suspicions is as big a problem as combating the Ebola virus that has plagued it for six months.

results.title: Nigeria seizes $220 million worth of meth, arrests 5 Mexican suspects
results.content: Nigerian authorities have seized more than $220 million worth of methamphetamine in a major operation in the country’s southeast, the national anti-drug agency announced on Wednesday. Five Mexican suspects have been arrested.

results.title: Brazilian forensic scientist identifies missing migrants on 'ghost ships'
results.content: The identify of migrants lost at sea often remains a mystery but Brazilian federal police investigator Alexandre Deitos decided to solve it.

results.title: UK sent Sri Lankan refugee to Eswatini in secret deal, the BBC says
results.content: The United Kingdom reportedly sent a Sri Lankan refugee who had been convicted of sexual assault to Eswatini, where he committed suicide, as part of a secret deal, according to an investigation by the BBC.

results.title: Relatives of Egypt highway fire victims wait for news outside Giza hospital
results.content: Dozens of people gathered outside Giza’s Imbaba General Hospital on Wednesday night, waiting for news of their relatives injured in a massive fire on a highway outside Cairo after a crash involving a fuel tanker.

results.title: Erdogan welcomes Haftar to Turkey amid push to strengthen ties with eastern Libya
results.content: Turkish President Erdogan welcomed Khalifa Haftar, the leader of eastern Libya, to Ankara on Wednesday, marking a major thaw in relations.

results.title: Nigeria opposition accuses ruling APC of attacks on presidential candidate Peter Obi
results.content: Nigeria’s opposition is accusing the ruling All Progressives Congress of orchestrating attacks on presidential candidates during campaign rallies across the country.

results.title: Forward7-ARSO Cooperation Agreement Delivers 45+ Standards to Support the Future of Clean Cooking in Africa
results.content: Saudi Arabia’s Forward7 and ARSO are harmonizing clean cooking standards across Africa to boost safe LPG, bioenergy and solar solutions for families.

results.title: Mozambique advance to Round of 32 after 2-2 draw with Australia
results.content: Mozambique have booked their place in the Round of 32 at the FIFA Under-17 World Cup in Qatar after drawing 2-2 with Australia in Group C.

results.title: Egypt advance to U-17 World Cup knockout stage as Haiti eliminated
results.content: Egypt secured a place in the knockout round of 32 after beating Panama 4-1 in a thrilling match in Qatar. They are the second African team to reach the next round, following Uganda, and finished second in Group A.

results.title: Egypt says 30 dead in Cairo fire after fuel truck crashes on highway
results.content: A crash involving a fuel tanker ignited a massive fire on a major highway surrounding Cairo on Wednesday, killing at least 30 people, Egyptian authorities said.

results.title: South Africa's Ramaphosa wins court bid over impeachment report
results.content: A South African court on Wednesday ruled in favour of President Cyril Ramaphosa, throwing out a report that fuelled efforts to impeach him over his handling of a cash theft at his private farm.

results.title: Uganda storm into U-17 World Cup round of 32 with 6-0 win
results.content: Uganda sealed qualification for the FIFA U-17 World Cup round of 32 with a commanding 6-0 win over New Caledonia.

results.title: Canary Islands record nearly 2,000 migrant arrivals in a single day
results.content: The Canary Islands maritime rescue service said 1,990 people reached the archipelago aboard 15 boats on Tuesday, with many departing from Senegal and Gambia.

results.title: Greece: 14,000 march in Athens against rising living costs
results.content: Thousands demonstrated across Greece on Wednesday 25 November 2026 during a 24-hour strike against rising living costs and stagnant wages. The industrial action disrupted metro services, grounded flights and kept ferries in port.
